pair_policy: Every study testcase has five browser screenshots plus API request/response/timing evidence and a binding file.

testcases.purpose: Pair public UI home with live gateway health.
Compare UI version label with API release version.
testcases.finding: UI v1.1.1 differs from API v1.2.0.

testcases.purpose: Verify the deployed API schema location and route-family documentation surface.
testcases.finding: OpenAPI is at /v3api/openapi.json; /api/openapi.json is not the schema URL.

testcases.purpose: Verify UI token guard and unauthenticated output endpoint guard.
testcases.finding: UI and API both require authentication; HTTP 401 observed.

testcases.purpose: Capture current worker capacity and health.
testcases.finding: 6 configured, 4 enabled/healthy, 2 disabled, capacity 6 at capture time.

testcases.purpose: Separate current node state from 24-hour historical metrics.
testcases.finding: Historical metrics can mention a node that is currently disabled.

testcases.purpose: Verify no-file UI guard and unauthenticated render guard without uploading media.
testcases.finding: Render was not evaluated as a real job; no token and no files were used.

testcases.purpose: Verify the public API prefix and distinguish it from frontend catch-all paths.
testcases.finding: /v3api/healthz returns JSON; root /healthz returns frontend HTML.
